name: socs_sys1
definition: Control: legume-rye cover crop every 4th year (Years 3 and 7 (fall 2006 and fall 2010; planted before Years 4 and 8 vegetable seasons)), no compost applied

name: socs_sys2
definition: Compost (7.6 Mg/ha/crop) + legume-rye cover crop every 4th year (Years 3 and 7 (fall 2006 and fall 2010; planted before Years 4 and 8 vegetable seasons))

name: socs_sys3
definition: Compost (7.6 Mg/ha/crop) + legume-rye cover crop every year, low seeding rate (1x)

name: socs_sys4
definition: Compost (7.6 Mg/ha/crop) + legume-rye cover crop every year

name: socs_sys5
definition: Compost (7.6 Mg/ha/crop) + mustard cover crop every year

name: socs_sys6
definition: Compost (7.6 Mg/ha/crop) + mustard cover crop every year, high seeding rate (3x)

name: socs_sys7
definition: Compost (7.6 Mg/ha/crop) + cereal rye cover crop every year

name: socs_sys8
definition: Compost (7.6 Mg/ha/crop) + cereal rye cover crop every year, high seeding rate (3x)

name: no_compost
definition: Nichols 2024: Control — no compost since 2012 replanting. HFLC drip fertigation ~195 kg N ha-1 (14 events). Western 5 ha. Modesto CA almond orchard.

name: compost
definition: Nichols 2024: Annual compost top-dress ~38 dry t ha-1 (Recology yard trimmings) since 2012 (7 yr). Compost: 20% org C, 1.6% N, C:N ~13. Same HFLC fertigation as no_compost. Eastern 5 ha.

name: conv_corn_tomato
definition: Conventional corn-tomato rotation, synthetic fertilizer N, no cover crop. UC Davis Century Experiment.

name: conv_corn_tomato_unassigned
definition: Conventional corn-tomato (plot 5-4) used for variety trials; baseline irrigation/fertilization. Variety-trial anomalies present in most years.

name: org_corn_tomato
definition: Organic corn-tomato rotation with composted poultry manure and winter cover crop; no synthetic N.

name: leg_corn_tomato
definition: Conventional corn-tomato rotation with winter legume cover crop replacing some/all synthetic N.

name: alf_corn_tomato
definition: Three-phase rotation: alfalfa -> corn -> tomato. Alfalfa-N feeds subsequent corn/tomato. Started 2012.

name: conv_wheat_tomato
definition: Conventional wheat-tomato rotation, synthetic fertilizer N, no cover crop.

name: irr_wheat_control
definition: Continuous irrigated wheat, conventional synthetic N, no cover crop.

name: irr_wheat_fallow
definition: Irrigated wheat-fallow rotation (alternating years).

name: irr_wheat_legume
definition: Irrigated wheat-legume rotation; ended 2011.

name: rf_wheat_control
definition: Continuous rainfed wheat, conventional synthetic N, no cover crop.

name: rf_wheat_fallow
definition: Rainfed wheat-fallow rotation (alternating years).

name: rf_wheat_legume
definition: Rainfed wheat-legume rotation.

name: native_grass
definition: Native-grass reference (unmanaged); planted 2012.

name: transitional
definition: Conventional-to-organic transition; 3 plots converted 1999.
